description: Action reuse assessment: SaveEmailConnector/EmailConnectorSettings are email-specific (SMTP dependencies, credential form schemas) so do not expand them with widget knowledge. New focused ManageWidgetConnector Action delegates to Engine-owned widget settings context; no agent-tool exposure. Confidential authenticated BO event invokes validated Jido.Exec path. Inputs op snapshot/save/key rotation/snippet, exact config ID and expected revision; fixed web_widget/retrieval scope, allowlisted params. Outputs secret-free snapshots/bounded errors, except generated key once to admin in confidential response. Reuse ChannelConfig changesets/token EncryptedString, ConnectorLifecycle archive and ConnectorRuntime sync; extend authoritative provider enablement validation with global base_url/adapter readiness. Preserve settings, transaction/stale edit protection, rotation forces fresh encrypted token and metadata revision, refresh server adapter runtime. Use IncomingMessageRouting connector-scoped writes/reads through supported events, not widget settings. Tests authorization, wrong/archived scope, stale mutation, encryption failure/no plaintext, atomic routing, prerequisites and post-save runtime warning. Consumer BO integration depends on this essential Action.

comments.text: Implemented Engine WidgetConnectorSettings and validated ManageWidgetConnector Action, confidential authenticated Engine event, allowlisted snapshots, locked exact config/revision, encrypted random key generation/rotation with once-only admin result, global base_url and adapter readiness enablement, connector-scoped IncomingMessageRouting writes. Reuse refined: existing :sync_channel_runtime/CommunicationBridge.sync_config_runtime before/after snapshots handles refresh/rotation; ConnectorRuntime archive-only stop contract unchanged. ChannelConfig prepare_changes adds authoritative base_url persistence guard. Numeric/string boolean casts cannot bypass guard. Runtime failure returns saved/pending warning; generated keys absent from ordinary snapshots. Reuse shared token encryption/lifecycle revision rather than parallel secrets or revisions. All issues remain open for review.
